label: A4B3_hP28_159_ab2c_2c-001
title: $\alpha$-Si$_{3}$N$_{4}$ (Nierite) Structure
comments:
Nierite can also be found in a hexagonal form, $\beta$-Si$_{3}$N$_{4}$, which exists in one of two space group: \href{current_web_home_dir/A4B3_hP14_173_bc_c-001}{polar space group $P6_{3}$ \#173} or \href{current_web_home_dir/A4B3_hP14_176_ch_h-001}{centrosymmetric space group $P6_{3}/m$ \#176}. The two structures are nearly indistinguishable. 
 The data for this structure was taken at 300K.
